description: This file defines extension methods for configuring ADO.NET persistent streams in Orleans cluster clients. It provides methods to add and configure streams with default or custom options.

classes.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring ADO.NET streams on IClientBuilder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams (string, Action<AdoNetStreamOptions>)
methods.description: Configures the Orleans cluster client to use ADO.NET persistent streams with default settings.

methods.name: AddAdoNetStreams (string, Action<ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator>)
methods.description: Configures the Orleans cluster client to use ADO.NET persistent streams with custom configuration.
